question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bad iron
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bad luck**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**Bad iron**" means bad luck.
 
• The term "**iron**" is being used metaphorically here to represent luck or fortune.
 
• This idiom is often used in informal conversation to express disappointment or frustration with a run of bad luck.
 
 
• For e
